items.headline: Game Day Kickoff: An epic QB showcase in Starkville and the best of the rest of Week 5
items.description: Kamario Taylor and Mississippi State will face their biggest test yet. Plus: teams on upset watch and other games to watch.

items.headline: Jorge Diaz Nicolas' field goal in final seconds lifts Marshall over Gardner-Webb 36-35
items.description: — Jorge Diaz Nicolas kicked a 32-yard field goal with six seconds left and Marshall rallied to beat upset-minded Gardner-Webb 36-35 on Saturday.

items.headline: Del Rio-Wilson, Marshall defense makes late save to blunt Missouri St. rally in 30-24 win
items.description: — Carlos Del Rio-Wilson accounted for 249 yards and two touchdowns and Marshall held off Missouri State for a 30-24 win on Saturday night.

items.headline: Turner-Bradshaw's 2 TDs rally Marshall over Middle Tennessee 28-26
items.description: — Xayvion Turner-Bradshaw caught a 69-yard touchdown pass and recovered a teammate’s fumble for the go-ahead touchdown as Marshall rallied past Middle Tennessee 28-26 on Saturday.
